subject.title: fix(subagents): preserve requester wake on visible delivery failure

question: Should required visible-delivery failure become terminal once requester wake succeeds, or remain independently retryable?
rationale: Both approaches preserve parent continuation, but they differ in cleanup, retry budget, detached-task status, restored state, and whether users may later receive the required completion message.

options.title: Accept terminal split
options.body: Credit requester wake, persist visible delivery as failed, clear pending state, and stop retries after exact-head proof.

options.title: Preserve independent retries
options.body: Credit requester wake while keeping required visible delivery pending until success or retry exhaustion.

recommendation.title: Accept terminal split
recommendation.body: Credit requester wake, persist visible delivery as failed, clear pending state, and stop retries after exact-head proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged history spans the completion-routing, cleanup, delivery-failure, and SQLite-registry behavior governed by this choice.
